text:
maya (product): Quick heads-up — ACME asked to compress their private-pilot timeline for billing flows. Theyre pushing for ~3 sprints. Need a tight cross-team plan: runtime perf + quant, infra reservations, security HSM/KMS, staging gating. Can someone own launch criteria? Meeting Friday 9am to confirm owners.

evan (eng-runtime): I can take runtime ops. Major call: try int8 quant w/ quality validation, otherwise fp16. We should preload common billing prompts into KV cache and set continuous batching for low tail latency. Rough config: 
``
prewarm: true
reserved_nodes: 2
cache_seed: ["billing_prefixes_v2"]
quant_profile: int8-if-pass
``
Will need customer prompt corpus for eval.

tariq (infra): On infra side we can earmark 2 GPUs in the Dedicated pool for the canary window. Need traffic numbers: baseline RPS, concurrency, and spike factor. Also need customer network peering/egress details for private deployment. Ill open INFRA-2181 and request those inputs.

jess (security): HSM note: if ACME mandates FIPS-certified HSM were looking at ~4 weeks for procurement/attestation — could block 3-sprint target. Fallback: tenant-managed KMS with customer-held keys (accept risk for pilot). We need ACME SOC2 contact and any required cipher lists. Whos owning compliance intake?

sam (release-manager): Proposed launch gates:
- Perf: p95 generation < 220ms on canary workloads
- Quality: no >5% degradation on key metrics vs baseline
- Infra: reserved capacity and prewarm complete
- Security: approved keying option in place
Rollout: flag -> 1% traffic 24h -> 10% 48h -> 100% gradual. Rollback triggers: error rate >1.5% or p95 >400ms sustained 15m. Fallback model: hosted small-model fallback route.

ben (pm-engineering): I'll own the eval harness and matrix. Plan to run a 48-hour A/B if we do int8 vs fp16. I'll create PROJ-4890, include owners/dates/blockers. Can someone drop the ACME prompt set into the shared drive?

lina (devex): I can help with the harness and metric dashboards (latency, tokens/call, quality scoring). Ben + I will pair on eval automation. Also recommend a small smoke script to run an end-to-end billing txn.

alok (sre): For canary observability, we need distributed traces, request sampling, and alerting thresholds. I'll add dashboards and a canary alert policy (error rate, latency, token blowups). Also propose scheduled prewarm 30m before cutover.

maya (product): Action list:
- evan: finalize quant decision + KV preload list (due Tue)
- tariq: INFRA-2181 ticket + reserve nodes (ETA Apr 10)
- jess: clarify HSM vs KMS tradeoffs with ACME, gather SOC2 contact (due Mon)
- ben/lina: eval harness + dashboard (start Mon)
- alok/sam: canary runbook + alerts + rollback criteria (draft Mon)
I'll confirm customer expectations in tomorrows sync and update the roadmap. If anyone can't make Friday 9am, post status here. :calendar:

evan (eng-runtime): One more technical nuance: int8 can cause subtle tokenization quality shifts on rare billing strings. Suggest a narrow A/B with manual review for top 20 customer-critical prompts. Ben — let's tag them in the eval.

jess (security): Adding risk: pilot with tenant-managed KMS = moderate compliance risk; flag for enterprise sales. I'll add to risk log and note that full GA requires HSM proof.

tariq (infra): INFRA-2181 created. I added questions: expected latency SLO, peak concurrency, allowed burst %, and network peering details. Please fill in.

sam (release-manager): I'll draft a preflight checklist including synthetic E2E billing transaction, perf smoke, regression eval pass, infra reservation check, security signoff. Will post runbook link here.

maya (product): Thanks — this is shaping up. Quick customer message to prep: we can aim for pilot in ~3 sprints if HSM is optional; if FIPS HSM is required, timeline slips. I'll surface that in the call and see if customer accepts KMS fallback for pilot. Meeting Friday 9am to lock owners. :eyes:
